_comment: The payoff was a second ability triggered on ON_BANISH, which is not a trigger name -- dispatch falls back to the raw string and matches nothing, so it never ran. 'Whenever THIS banishes' means the banish this card just did, so it is a CONDITIONAL in the SAME ability, reading the `banished` ref BANISH now records. No new engine event needed. The test was CARD_IN_ZONE(REACTION) plus OR(CARD_IN_ZONE(INSTANT)); a conditions list is AND-ed, so it demanded BOTH a reaction AND an instant -- an AND wearing an OR's clothes. The type list names the REAL printed types: FAB has no bare 'Reaction' type -- they are AttackReaction and DefenseReaction, spelled without a space -- so a list saying 'Reaction' would match nothing and turn 'always paid off' into 'never pays off'.
